prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a gallery-quality landscape artwork for a desktop app lesson about compassion, power protecting vulnerability, and love for all creatures. Wide 16:9 composition. A magnificent naturalistic adult lion rests peacefully beside a small lamb in a quiet meadow, both alert but relaxed, the lion's muzzle gently inclined toward the lamb. Neither animal is injured, restrained, anthropomorphized or threatening. Above them a vast blue-violet night sky carries an exquisitely subtle luminous sphere of stars and faint warm gold orbital arcs, like a poetic canopy. Painterly photographic realism, extraordinary fur and wool texture, believable anatomy, delicate grasses, restrained amber rim light, deep ink-blue shadows, cinematic depth, emotionally tender and bittersweet rather than saccharine, elegant museum illustration. Both creatures equally cared for, the lamb safe and the lion dignified. No text, letters, UI, symbols of ownership, borders or watermark. This is symbolic art, not a scientific diagram.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an exceptionally polished wide 16:9 landscape artwork for a lesson titled in the app 'All creatures, great and small' (do not write any text in the image). A translucent luminous spherical world suspended in deep indigo space, its surface formed by subtle constellations and fine golden threads. Across a graceful foreground landscape and water margin are a deer, a fox, a small bird, a butterfly, reeds, a flowering plant and a glimpse of fish beneath clear water, all naturalistic and tranquil; a distant lion silhouette belongs to the same living world. Every creature and plant looks individually cherished, not a crowded collage or taxonomic chart. Nested scales of life, quiet connection, vulnerability supported by a living environment. Deep navy, soft teal, muted violet and warm pearl-gold. Premium cinematic matte painting with tactile realism and restrained celestial luminosity. Spacious composition, profound tenderness, bittersweet beauty, no cartoon styling, no harsh neon, no text, no logos or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a beautiful wide 16:9 landscape artwork for a desktop app's symbolic lesson about protecting fragile life. An ORIGINAL tiny porcelain figurine with a simple gentle human form, fully clothed in an ivory ceramic dress, sits safely on a mossy stone beneath a protective arch of translucent warm light. The figurine is intact, serene and finely glazed, with subtle handmade texture; it is not an existing film character. A delicate butterfly rests beside its outstretched ceramic hand. A small seedling grows nearby. Protective curving forms suggest shelter without cages or confinement. Background is a vast soft-focus blue-violet cosmic sphere and a faint dawn horizon. Extraordinary macro detail, museum-grade luminous illustration, convincing ceramic, moss and butterfly materials. Quiet care, dignity, safety and boundless tenderness, never horror or broken-body imagery. Rich midnight blue, warm gold and pearly ivory, restrained magical realism. No text, UI, religious claims in writing, labels, watermark or borders.
